creator: Alexander Terp
description: Found 2026-11-19 while settling a sidebar width test. With a mouse attached, macOS prefers legacy scrollers, and the agent list's scroll view (Sources/MusterMac/Sidebar.swift, hasVerticalScroller = true) then always shows a 17-point scroller, so rows are 183 wide in a 200-point list even when the list does not overflow. autohidesScrollers = true would give the room back until the list overflows. Not changed: it is a visible change to how the list looks, so it is the owner's call.
title: With a mouse attached, the agent list loses 17 points to a scrollbar that shows even when nothing scrolls
